title: BPW-2026-0476
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0476
CD 14
TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) NO. ED21-055 – HOLLENBECK PARK LAKE REHABILITATION AND SEWER REPLACEMENT PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue the task to Environmental Science Associates from the Pre-Qualified On-Call Environmental Documentation Consultant Services List to provide an Environmental Impact Report for the Hollenbeck Park Lake Rehabilitation and Sewer Replacement Project, as stated in TOS No. ED21-055, with a budget authority of $1,376,000, including contingency.
(W.O.: S333HPLR, SZC14544, C-139063)
summary: Authorization to issue task for Environmental Impact Report for Hollenbeck Park Lake Rehabilitation and Sewer Replacement Project.

outcome.text: REPORT ADOPTED, SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS, FORTHWITH
